meta.name: home-ops-deployer
meta.description: Deploy and manage applications in the home-ops Kubernetes cluster via GitOps. Use when deploying new apps, modifying existing ones, adding routing, managing secrets, or working with the home-ops repo structure.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把应用部署进家庭服务器集群,持续管理配置、路由与密钥
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在家用服务器上跑服务,想用 Git 方式管理部署
copy.tagline_en: Deploy apps on your home cluster and manage config, routing, and secrets.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run services on a home server and want Git-based deployment management.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会通过编辑并推送 ~/home-ops 仓库里的文件来部署或修改家庭集群中的应用,所有改动经 Git 和 Flux 生效,不会直接操作集群;同时会遵循内置规范,如固定镜像摘要、加密密钥等,以减少错误。
howto.when: 当你要部署新应用、修改现有应用或添加路由时触发;管理密钥、调整仓库结构等场景也会介入。

say.text: 在home-ops里帮我部署一个新应用,用app-template模板
say.note: 会生成目录结构、HelmRelease并提交推送

say.text: 把这个应用改成仅内网访问,使用internal网关
say.note: 会更新路由配置并走Git推送生效

say.text: 给这个应用加一个从1Password读取的ExternalSecret

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude deploys or modifies apps in the home-ops cluster by editing and pushing files in ~/home-ops. Changes take effect through Git and Flux, not direct cluster commands. It follows conventions like image digests and encrypted secrets.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to deploy a new app, modify an existing app, or add routing, and similar home-ops tasks.

say_en.text: Deploy a new app in home-ops using the app-template chart.
say_en.note: Creates the directory, HelmRelease, and commits.

say_en.text: Change this app to internal-only access with the internal gateway.
say_en.note: Updates routing and pushes via Git.

say_en.text: Add an ExternalSecret reading from 1Password for this app.
say_en.note: Creates the ExternalSecret and wires envFrom.
